sourceSentences: [0] Nilah is basically like loading into the game as a level one goblin and the enemies are like level 10 archers.
[0] Now, because I I got the XP, I'm up in levels.

[1] Your W makes you dodge auto attacks and reduces magic damage.
[1] Your ult is a circle that pulls enemies in and does damage. And your passive gives you and your allies bonus experience when you last hit a minion
[1] I struggled with Nilah's W, both using it at the correct time, but also not understanding how vulnerable I was without it.
[1] I was learning to use Nilah's passive to fight enemies when I was a higher level, kind of making up for my weak early game.
[1] Sure, you can poke her from long range, but if she gets a lead, there is nothing the enemy can do. I also realized the only way Nilah can fight is by going all in.
[1] Nilah is possibly the only AD carry in the game that can truly engage fights with her dash ult combo, or her ult flash combo.
[2] She is very mobile and she gets a ton of free experience. However, she isn't the strongest laner
[2] Nilah's W grants a bonus move speed, reduces incoming magic damage and dodges all basic attacks.
[2] You need two fewer minions to hit your level three power spike and far less to hit your level six.

[2] And Nilah is not a poke champion where you're looking to occasionally trade attacks. At level three or level six or whenever you take any fight, every fight you're trying to go for is an all-in to the death.
[2] This allows you to E into the team fight using Q while dashing and then instantly combo into your ultimate
[2] So, wait for the fight to start, double jump into the center of the action, and use your ultimate.
